text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, clack…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I was training with Manhattan Cafe a minute ago…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So how did I end up in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This place is a fleeting dream… A chasm in time… where thoughts bend and intersect…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Right now, something is crying, drowning in sadness… Their sadness runs deep, and it's strong enough to power this train…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surprised, I turn to the window and see the night sky stretching out before me endlessly. She's right. This sure isn't the real world…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice that the train's beginning to pick up speed. Where could it be taking us?

text_block_list.name: Announcement?
text_block_list.text: The next station is Frutetinifni… I repeat, Frutetinifni…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Doesn't sound like any station I know… It must stand for something… their desire maybe… An endless yearning…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Think hard about the station name… then decide whether or not to get off the train…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do so, and I'm sure that something will—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before she can finish speaking, the train screeches to a halt and cuts her off. Outside the window, I see slopes, a dirt track, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe really urged me to think about the name of this place. And that's why I'm going to…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frutetinifni… What if… Acting on a gut feeling, I decide to get off the train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I step off and, instead of falling down a bottomless pit, find myself on solid ground.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… There you are.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that white stuff?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spin around in a panic to see that, sure enough, something like a white mist is rising up behind me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I understand now… If you read "Frutetinifni" backwards… you get "infinite turf."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The something that's in this dream… it wanted to visit this place one more time, and not alone either.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And now its dream has come true… Farewell…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The white mist dissipates into a shimmer of sparkles and fades away into the sky. Whatever that was, it seems to have found peace and moved on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You really are a kind person… Today reminded me of that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes… You accept the existence of those you cannot see… and you lend an ear to their voices…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one who's grateful for that… That's become very clear to me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If anything, I feel like Manhattan Cafe's efforts to understand and advocate for the mysterious show more kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that I probably shouldn't get off yet, I choose to stay on the train. Before long, it begins to move again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, clack…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, clack. Click, clack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It is just me or… is the train getting faster?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, clack! Click, clack! Click, clack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment I realize the gravity of the situation, I feel as if I've been sent flying through the air. And that's when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clatter, clatter, clatter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stumble right onto the central plaza and notice several students running this way! If they come any closer…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe darts to my side and saves me just in the nick of time…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I understand the dream now… If you read "Frutetinifni" backwards, you get "infinite turf."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The something that's in this dream… it wants to visit that place one more time, and not alone either. Let's go…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I knew it. This is where you wanted to come, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I hope you find peace, no matter how fleeting it might be… Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The white mist dissipates into a shimmer of sparkles and fades away into the sky. Whatever that was, it seems to have found peace and moved on.
choice_data_list: I can't believe you figured out what it wanted.
I can't believe you figured out what it wanted.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They're fragile, only a moment from disappearing…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want to share their feelings as best as I can, before they fade away…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Manhattan Cafe talks about her efforts to connect with the strange and mysterious, I sense a deep kindness in her.
